scope: Static duplicate-label registration and dispatch lead; not a native reference-copy implementation or acceptance

observations.label: Duplicate selected entities
observations.registration: In the byte-verified exact 0x5c99c0 range, a reference to the label precedes a virtual call with 0x1f1 and 0x8341 as arguments. The full receiver and argument semantics are not established.
observations.dispatchCandidate: In five byte-verified unwind-linked fragments rooted at 0x5c89c0, a conditional path calls an indirect target with values 0x111 and 0x8341 and a window-like pointer. A fresh hidden owned-process capture observed the exact slot twice and mapped it within the child's USER32.dll module snapshot. The same module-relative offset matches the on-disk SendMessageW export; the disk image was not compared byte-for-byte with the mapped module. This supports a SendMessageW dispatch inference, not identification of the destination handler.
observations.tableConstruction: Two byte-verified ranges store the candidate table addresses 0x1411b1778 and 0x1411b1b50 on the same object at offsets 0 and 0x130. Adjacent RTTI metadata alone does not establish full table extents or a live receiver.
observations.importInspection: The initial standard-import lookup failed its expected-match assertion. A subsequent standard and delay import check found no matching entry and no delay directory; the failed receipt is retained. The earlier captured pointer was from a previous Windows boot and was not matched to current system addresses.
observations.otherCandidates: The byte candidate at 0x5c9256 falls inside an exact 1,319-byte exception range, but a bounded listing covered only 57 bytes and did not list that candidate. Its decompiler followed code outside the stated range, so neither the jump nor the decompiled paths establish the receiver. Three other value matches have been retained as metadata: two contexts resemble the known dispatch and one may be a call displacement. None is instruction-verified or establishes a handler.

verification.nativeExecution: Static listings did not execute native code. A separate hidden owned-process startup read only the exact 8-byte slot twice, without UI input or target ABI calls.

remaining: Bind the actual destination handler and runtime receiver without assuming table extent or mapped-module identity.
Observe original reference duplication eligibility, identity, links, history and save/reopen before claiming native parity.
